en.quote: Luna 25, the first lunar lander, will launch from Vostochny in October [2021].
en.head: Luna 25 launched late and crashed.
en.body: Luna 25 launched on August 11, 2023, roughly 22 months after the promised October 2021 date. On August 20, Roscosmos said it had collided with the Moon after entering an unintended orbit. The delayed launch and failed landing are separate outcomes.
